chunks: The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said: Whoever travels a path seeking knowledge therein, God will cause him to travel a path to Paradise. The angels lay down their wings for the seeker of knowledge out of pleasure with him. Those in the heavens and those in the earth — even the fish in the sea — seek forgiveness for the seeker of knowledge.

The merit of the scholar over the worshipper is like the merit of the moon over all other stars on the night of the full moon. The scholars are the inheritors of the Prophets — the Prophets left no dinar or dirham as inheritance; rather, they bequeathed knowledge. So whoever takes from it has taken an abundant share.

key_terms.العلماء وَرَثَةُ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ: The scholars are the inheritors of the Prophets — a prophetic maxim establishing the religious authority of scholars
key_terms.حظ وافر: An abundant share — used in the Quran (4:7) to describe a full share of inheritance
key_terms.طالب العلم: Seeker of knowledge — one who actively pursues religious learning

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about the rewards for seeking knowledge and the scholars?
ai.summary: This hadith, narrated by Imam al-Sadiq (AS) from the Prophet (SAWW), extols the exceptional spiritual station of seeking knowledge and the scholars who transmit it. In the early Islamic community, the pursuit of religious knowledge was understood as a sacred duty equivalent to worship, with divine reward flowing from every step taken in its pursuit. The closing declaration — 'the scholars are the inheritors of the Prophets' — establishes the continuity of prophetic authority through scholarly transmission, a foundational principle in Shia Islamic thought.
